names: Princess of the King of Qin and Jin

label.en: Attendant Prince Guard Corps detail officer
associate administrator of the Palace Front Command
Right Attendant Prince Guard Corps detail officer
chanshi of the imperial maternal uncle separate division

units.zh: 蕭阿剌耶律義先
units.en: Xiao Ala; Yelu Yixian
units.literal: Xiao Ala; Yelu Yixian

units.en: (Xinxian)〉
units.literal: (Xinxian)〉

units.zh: 蕭陶隗蕭塔剌葛耶律敵祿
units.en: Xiao Taowei; Xiao Talage; Yelu Dilu
units.literal: Xiao Taowei; Xiao Talage; Yelu Dilu

units.zh: 蕭阿剌，字阿裏懶，北院樞密使孝穆之子也。
units.en: Xiao Ala, styled Alailan, was the son of Northern Court Privy Commissioner Xiao Xiaomu.
units.literal: Xiao Ala, style name Alailan, was the son of Northern Court Privy Commissioner Xiaomu.

units.zh: 幼養宮中，興宗尤愛之。
units.en: Raised in the palace from childhood, he was especially beloved by Emperor Xingzong.
units.literal: Reared in the palace from childhood, he was especially beloved by Emperor Xingzong.

units.zh: 重熙六年，為弘義宮使。
units.en: In the sixth year of Chongxi he was appointed Hongyi Palace commissioner.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Chongxi he was made Hongyi Palace commissioner.

units.zh: 累遷同知北院樞密使，加同中書門下平章事，出為東京留守。
units.en: He rose to associate Northern Court privy commissioner, was given the additional title of Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and was sent out as Eastern Capital regent.
units.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to associate Northern Court privy commissioner, given the additional title of Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and sent out as Eastern Capital regent.

units.zh: 二十一年，拜西北路招討使，封西平郡王。
units.en: In the twenty-first year he was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner and enfeoffed Prince of Xiping Commandery.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year he was appointed Northwest Route pacification commissioner and enfeoffed Prince of Xiping Commandery.

units.zh: 尋尚秦晉國王公主，拜駙馬都尉。
units.en: Soon afterward he married the Princess of the King of Qin and Jin and was appointed imperial son-in-law commandant.
units.literal: Soon afterward he married the princess of the King of Qin and Jin and was appointed imperial son-in-law commandant.

units.zh: 清寧元年，遺詔拜北府宰相，兼南院樞密使，進王韓。
units.en: In the first year of Qingning, by testamentary edict he was made Northern Court chancellor and Southern Court privy commissioner and was advanced to Prince of Han.
units.literal: In the first year of Qingning, by testamentary edict he was made Northern Court chancellor, concurrently Southern Court privy commissioner, and advanced to Prince of Han.

units.zh: 明年，改北院樞密使，徙王陳，與蕭革同掌國政。
units.en: The next year he became Northern Court privy commissioner, was moved to Prince of Chen, and shared control of government with Xiao Ge.
units.literal: The next year he was transferred to Northern Court privy commissioner, moved to Prince of Chen, and jointly directed state affairs with Xiao Ge.

units.zh: 革諂諛不法，阿剌爭之不得，告歸。
units.en: Ge was sycophantic and lawless; Ala argued with him in vain and asked to retire.
units.literal: Ge was sycophantic and lawless; Ala contended with him without success and requested leave to return home.

units.zh: 上由此惡之，除東京留守。
units.en: The emperor took a dislike to him for this and made him Eastern Capital regent.
units.literal: The emperor came to dislike him for this and appointed him Eastern Capital regent.

units.zh: 會行瑟瑟禮，入朝陳時政得失。
units.en: During the sese ritual he came to court and laid out what was right and wrong in current policy.
units.literal: When the sese ritual was performed, he came to court and stated the gains and losses of current policy.

units.zh: 革以事中傷，帝怒，縊殺之。
units.en: Ge used the affair to strike at him; the emperor flew into a rage and had him strangled.
units.literal: Ge used the affair to wound him; the emperor was enraged and had him strangled.

units.zh: 皇太后營救不及，大慟曰：「阿剌何罪而遽見殺？」
units.en: The empress dowager could not save him in time and wailed, "What crime did Ala commit that he should be killed so suddenly?"
units.literal: The empress dowager could not rescue him in time and grieved greatly, saying, "What crime did Ala commit that he should be killed so suddenly?"

units.zh: 帝乃優加賻贈，葬乾陵之赤山。
units.en: The emperor then granted generous funeral gifts and buried him at Red Mountain beside Qianling.
units.literal: The emperor then granted generous funeral gifts and buried him at Red Mountain by Qianling.

units.zh: 阿剌性忠果，曉世務，有經濟才。
units.en: Ala was loyal and upright by nature, well versed in public affairs, and possessed real talent for governing the state.
units.literal: Ala was by nature loyal and resolute, understood the affairs of the age, and had talent for statecraft.

units.zh: 議者以謂阿剌若在，無重元、乙辛之亂。
units.en: Commentators held that had Ala still lived, the Chongyuan rebellion and the Yixin faction would never have arisen.
units.literal: Discussants said that if Ala had still been alive, there would have been no disorders of Chongyuan and Yixin.

units.zh: 耶律義先，於越仁先之弟也。
units.en: Yelu Yixian was the younger brother of the yuyue Renxian.
units.literal: Yelu Yixian was the younger brother of yuyue Renxian.

units.zh: 美風姿，舉止嚴重。
units.en: Handsome in appearance and solemn in manner.
units.literal: He was handsome in bearing and grave in demeanor.

units.zh: 重熙初，補祗候郎君班詳穩。
units.en: Early in the Chongxi era he entered the Attendant Prince Guard Corps as a detail officer.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Chongxi reign he was appointed to the Attendant Prince Guard Corps as detail officer.

units.zh: 十三年，車駕西征，為十二行糺都監，戰功最，改南院宣徽使。
units.en: In the thirteenth year, during the emperor's western campaign, he was made commander-in-chief of the twelve columns and won the greatest military merit; he was then promoted to Southern Court palace commissioner.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year, when the imperial carriage campaigned westward, he served as commander-in-chief of the twelve columns, with the foremost battle merit; he was transferred to Southern Court palace commissioner.

units.zh: 時蕭革同知樞密院事，席寵擅權，義先疾之。
units.en: Xiao Ge was then associate administrator of the Privy Council, privileged and grasping power, and Yixian loathed him.
units.literal: At that time Xiao Ge was associate administrator of the Privy Council, enjoying favor and monopolizing power; Yixian detested him.

units.zh: 因侍宴，言於帝曰：「革狡佞喜亂，一朝大用，必誤國家！」
units.en: At a palace banquet he told the emperor, "Ge is cunning, servile, and fond of turmoil; the moment he is given great authority, he will surely ruin the realm!"
units.literal: On one occasion while attending a feast he said to the emperor: "Ge is crafty and fawning and delights in disorder; once greatly employed, he is sure to bring error upon the state!"

units.zh: 言甚激切，不納。
units.en: He spoke with fierce urgency, but the emperor would not heed him.
units.literal: His words were very impassioned and forceful, but were not accepted.

units.zh: 它日侍宴，上命群臣博，負者罰一巨觥。
units.en: On another banquet day the emperor ordered the ministers to play at dice; whoever lost had to drink a huge goblet as penalty.
units.literal: On another day while attending a feast, the emperor ordered the ministers to gamble; the loser was fined one great goblet.

units.zh: 義先當與革對，憮然曰：「臣縱不能進賢退不肖，安能與國賊博哉！」
units.en: Yixian was matched against Ge. He flushed with anger and said, "I may not be able to promote the worthy and remove the unworthy, but how could I cast dice with a traitor to the state!"
units.literal: Yixian was to be paired against Ge; he said in agitation: "Your subject, though unable to advance the worthy and dismiss the unworthy, how can I gamble with a traitor to the state!"

units.zh: 帝止之曰：「卿醉矣！」
units.en: The emperor cut him off: "You are drunk!"
units.literal: The emperor stopped him, saying: "You are drunk!"

units.zh: 義先厲聲詬不已。
units.en: Yixian kept on hurling abuse at Ge in a loud voice.
units.literal: Yixian ceaselessly reviled him in a loud voice.

units.zh: 上大怒，賴皇后救，得解。
units.en: The emperor flew into a rage; only the empress's intervention saved him.
units.literal: The emperor was greatly enraged; thanks to the empress's rescue, he was spared.

units.zh: 翌日，上謂革曰：「義先無禮，當黜之。」
units.en: Next day the emperor told Ge, "Yixian was insolent and ought to be removed from office."
units.literal: The next day the emperor said to Ge: "Yixian was without propriety and ought to be dismissed."

units.zh: 革對曰：「義先天性忠直，今以酒失而出，誰敢言人之過？」
units.en: Ge answered, "Yixian is upright by nature; if he is dismissed for a drunken lapse, who will dare point out anyone else's faults?"
units.literal: Ge replied: "Yixian is loyal and upright by nature; now dismissed for a wine offense, who would dare speak of another's fault?"

units.zh: 上謂革忠直，益加信任。
units.en: The emperor took Ge for loyal and straightforward, and trusted him all the more.
units.literal: The emperor regarded Ge as loyal and upright and increased his trust in him.

units.zh: 義先郁郁不自得，然議事未嘗少沮。
units.en: Yixian brooded and felt ill at ease, yet he never flagged in council debates.
units.literal: Yixian was depressed and ill at ease, yet in deliberating affairs he never slackened in the least.

units.zh: 又於上前博，義先祝曰：「向言人過，冒犯天威。
units.en: Gambling again before the throne, Yixian said in prayer, "When I spoke of another man's faults I offended your majesty.
units.literal: Again while gambling before the emperor, Yixian prayed: "Earlier in speaking of another's fault I offended the imperial majesty.

units.zh: 今日一擲，可表愚款。」
units.en: With this one cast today I can show my humble loyalty."
units.literal: Today with one throw I can express my earnest sincerity."

units.zh: 俄得堂印。
units.en: He promptly threw the Hall emblem.
units.literal: Before long he obtained the Hall seal.

units.zh: 上愕然。
units.en: The emperor was astonished.
units.literal: The emperor was startled.

units.zh: 十六年，為殿前都點檢，討蒲奴裏，多所招降，獲其酋長陶得裏以歸，手詔褒獎，以功改南京統軍使，封武昌郡王。
units.en: In the sixteenth year he was made Palace Front Command inspector; he campaigned against Punnuli, won many surrenders, and returned with the tribal chief Taodeli; the emperor wrote him a personal commendation, and for his merit he was made Nanjing military governor and enfeoffed Prince of Wuchang Commandery.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year he was palace front command inspector; in punishing Punnuli he induced many to surrender, brought back their chieftain Taodeli, received an imperial autograph commendation, and for merit was transferred to Nanjing military governor, enfeoffed Prince of Wuchang Commandery.

units.zh: 奏請統軍司錢營息，以贍貧民。
units.en: He memorialized that the command headquarters' funds be lent at interest to support the destitute.
units.literal: He memorialized requesting that the military commander's office funds be invested at interest to support the poor.

units.zh: 未期，軍器完整，民得休息。
units.en: Before his term was out, the armory was in good order and the people were given relief.
units.literal: Before the term expired, weapons were complete and the people obtained rest.

units.zh: 二十一年，拜惕隱，進王富春，薨，年四十二。
units.en: In the twenty-first year he was appointed tiyin, promoted to Prince of Fuchun, and died at forty-two.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year he was appointed tiyin, advanced to Prince of Fuchun, and died at age forty-two.

units.zh: 義先常戒其族人曰：「國中三父房，皆帝之昆弟，不孝不義尤不可為。」
units.en: Yixian often admonished his kin: "In the realm the three paternal houses are all the emperor's uterine brothers; nothing is more forbidden than filial impiety and unrighteous conduct."
units.literal: Yixian often warned his clansmen: "Within the state the three paternal houses are all the emperor's uterine brothers; lack of filial piety and righteousness is especially what must not be done."

units.zh: 其接下無貴賤賢否，皆與均禮。
units.en: Toward everyone beneath him, noble or humble, worthy or not, he showed the same courtesy.
units.literal: In receiving others, without regard for noble or base, worthy or not, he treated all with equal courtesy.

units.zh: 其妻晉國長公主之女，每遇中表親，非禮服不見，故內外多化之。
units.en: His wife was a daughter of the Princess of Jin; whenever she received imperial collaterals she refused an audience unless properly robed, and so manners spread through the household and beyond.
units.literal: His wife was the daughter of the Princess of Jin; whenever she met collateral kin of the imperial clan she would not appear without full ceremonial dress, so within and without the household many were transformed by it.

units.zh: 清寧間，追贈許王。
units.en: In the Qingning period he was posthumously created Prince of Xu.
units.literal: During the Qingning era he was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Xu.

units.zh: 弟信先。
units.en: His younger brother was Xinxian.
units.literal: Younger brother Xinxian.

units.zh: 信先，興宗以其父瑰引為刺血友，幼養於宮。
units.en: Xinxian: Emperor Xingzong had sworn blood brotherhood with his father Guiyin, and Xinxian was raised in the palace from boyhood.
units.literal: Xinxian — because his father Guiyin was Emperor Xingzong's blood-oath friend, he was reared in the palace from childhood.

units.zh: 善騎射。
units.en: He was skilled in riding and archery.
units.literal: He excelled at mounted archery.

units.zh: 重熙十四年為左護衛太保，同知殿前點檢司事。
units.en: In the fourteenth year of Chongxi he became Left Guard Protector Grand Steward and associate administrator of the Palace Front Command.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year of Chongxi he was Left Guard Protector Grand Steward and associate administrator of the Palace Front Command.

units.zh: 十八年，兼右祗候郎君班詳穩。
units.en: In the eighteenth year he was concurrently Right Attendant Prince Guard Corps detail officer.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year he was also appointed Right Attendant Prince Guard Corps detail officer.

units.zh: 上問所欲，信先曰：「先臣瑰引與陛下分如同氣，然不及王封。
units.en: The emperor asked his wish; Xinxian said, "My late father Guiyin was as close to Your Majesty as a uterine brother, yet never received a royal title.
units.literal: The emperor asked what he desired; Xinxian said: "My late father Guiyin shared with Your Majesty a bond like uterine brothers, yet did not attain a princely enfeoffment.

units.zh: 儻使蒙恩地下，臣願畢矣。」
units.en: If he could receive your grace in the nether world, this subject's desire would be complete."
units.literal: If he might receive grace in the underworld, your subject's wish would be fulfilled."

units.zh: 上曰：「此朕遺忘之過。」
units.en: The emperor said, "That was my forgetfulness."
units.literal: The emperor said: "This is a lapse I forgot."

units.zh: 追封燕王。
units.en: Guiyin was posthumously created Prince of Yan.
units.literal: He was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Yan.

units.zh: 是年，從蕭惠伐夏，敗於河南，例被責。
units.en: That year, campaigning against Xia under Xiao Hui, he was among those defeated south of the Yellow River and was censured according to regulation.
units.literal: That year, following Xiao Hui in attacking Xia, defeated south of the Yellow River, he was punished according to precedent.

units.zh: 清寧初，為南面林牙，卒。
units.en: At the opening of Qingning he served as Southern Court linya and died.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qingning he was Southern Court linya and died.

units.zh: 蕭陶隗，字烏古鄰，宰相轄特六世孫。
units.en: Xiao Taowei, styled Wugulin, was a sixth-generation descendant of Chancellor Xiate.
units.literal: Xiao Taowei, style name Wugulin, was the sixth-generation descendant of Chancellor Xiate.

units.zh: 剛直有威重。
units.en: Upright and stern, he carried real moral weight.
units.literal: Upright and firm, with authoritative weight.

units.zh: 咸雍初，任馬群太保。
units.en: At the start of the Xianyong era he was made Horse Herds Grand Steward.
units.literal: At the beginning of Xianyong he was appointed Horse Herds Grand Steward.

units.zh: 素知群牧名存實亡，悉閱舊籍，除其羸病，錄其實數，牧人畏服。
units.en: Knowing the herd offices had long been hollow in name, he combed every old register, culled the sick and weak, wrote down true counts, and the herders bowed to him in respect.
units.literal: He had long known that the herd offices existed in name but not in fact; he went through all old registers, removed the weak and sick, recorded the true numbers, and the herders submitted in awe.

units.zh: 陶隗上書曰：「群牧以少為多，以無為有。
units.en: Taowei wrote, "The herds are reported as many when they are few, as existing when there are none.
units.literal: Taowei memorialized saying: "The herd offices make few into many and nothing into something.

units.zh: 上下相蒙，積弊成風。
units.en: Superiors and subordinates conceal the truth from each other until abuse has hardened into custom.
units.literal: Superiors and subordinates deceive one another; accumulated abuses have become custom.

units.zh: 不若括見真數，著為定籍，公私兩濟。」
units.en: Better to total the true counts on the ground, set them as a fixed register, and serve both state and herdsmen."
units.literal: It would be better to reckon the visible true numbers, fix them as a settled register, and benefit both public and private."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The court approved his plan.
units.literal: The memorial was adopted.

units.zh: 畜產歲以蕃息。
units.en: Livestock grew every year thereafter.
units.literal: Livestock increased year by year.

units.zh: 大康中，累遷契丹行宮都部署。
units.en: In the Dakang period he rose to Khitan Mobile Palace deployment director.
units.literal: During the Dakang era he was repeatedly promoted to Khitan Mobile Palace deployment director.

units.zh: 上嘗謂群臣曰：「北樞密院軍國重任，久闕其人，耶律阿思、蕭斡特剌二人孰愈？」
units.en: The emperor once asked the ministers, "The Northern Privy Council carries the weight of army and realm, yet the post has stood empty; between Yelü Asi and Xiao Wotela, which man is superior?"
units.literal: The emperor once said to the ministers: "The Northern Privy Council bears the heavy responsibility of army and state; for long the post has lacked a fit man — between Yelü Asi and Xiao Wotela, which is the better?"

units.zh: 群臣各譽所長，陶隗獨默然。
units.en: Each minister praised his favorite; only Taowei said nothing.
units.literal: The ministers each praised the merits of the one they favored; Taowei alone was silent.

units.zh: 上問：「卿何不言？」
units.en: The emperor asked, "Why do you not speak?"
units.literal: The emperor asked: "Why do you not speak?"

units.zh: 陶隗曰：「斡特剌懦而敗事；
units.en: Taowei answered, "Wotela is timid and will ruin affairs;
units.literal: Taowei said: "Wotela is timid and spoils affairs;

units.zh: 阿思有才而貪，將為禍基。
units.en: Asi has ability but is greedy; he will be the seed of calamity.
units.literal: Asi has talent but is greedy and will become the root of disaster.

units.zh: 不得已而用，敗事猶勝基禍。」
units.en: If you have no choice but to use him, a ruined policy is still better than planting disaster."
units.literal: If one must employ him unwillingly, ruining affairs is still better than laying the root of disaster."

units.zh: 上曰：「陶隗雖魏征不能過，但恨吾不及太宗爾！」
units.en: The emperor said, "Taowei could not be outdone even by Wei Zheng — I only wish I were no less a ruler than Emperor Taizong of Tang!"
units.literal: The emperor said: "Though Taowei cannot be surpassed even by Wei Zheng, I only regret that I am not the equal of Emperor Taizong!"

units.zh: 然竟以阿思為樞密使。
units.en: Yet in the end Asi was appointed Privy Commissioner.
units.literal: Yet in the end Asi was made privy commissioner.

units.zh: 由是阿思銜之。
units.en: From then on Asi resented him.
units.literal: From this Asi bore a grudge against him.

units.zh: 九年，西圉不寧，阿思奏曰：「邊隅事大，可擇重臣鎮撫。」
units.en: In the ninth year, when the western border was troubled, Asi memorialized, "The frontier is grave business; send a senior minister to steady it."
units.literal: In the ninth year the western marches were unsettled; Asi memorialized saying: "Frontier matters are weighty; one may choose a weighty minister to pacify them."

units.zh: 上曰：「陶隗何如？」
units.en: The emperor asked, "What of Taowei?"
units.literal: The emperor said: "How would Taowei do?"

units.zh: 阿思曰：「誠如聖旨。」
units.en: Asi replied, "Precisely as Your Majesty says."
units.literal: Asi said: "Truly as the holy edict states."

units.zh: 遂拜西南面招討使。
units.en: Taowei was promptly made Southwest Route pacification commissioner.
units.literal: Taowei was then appointed Southwest Route pacification commissioner.

units.zh: 阿思陰與蕭阿忽帶誣奏賊掠漠南牧馬及居民畜產，陶隗不急追捕，罪當死，詔免官。
units.en: Asi conspired with Xiao Ahudai to accuse him falsely of failing to pursue raiders who had seized herd horses and civilian livestock in the Southern Desert; the offense was capital, but an edict merely removed him from office.
units.literal: Asi secretly joined with Xiao Ahudai in a false memorial that bandits had plundered Southern Desert herd horses and the people's livestock; Taowei did not press the pursuit hotly — the crime warranted death; an edict stripped him of office.

units.zh: 久之，起為塌母城節度使。
units.en: After a long interval he was recalled as military commissioner of Tamu city.
units.literal: After long delay he was reappointed military commissioner of Tamu city.

units.zh: 未行，疽發背卒。
units.en: Before he set out, a carbuncle on his back burst and he died.
units.literal: Before he could depart, an abscess broke out on his back and he died.

units.zh: 陶隗負氣，怒則須髯輒張。
units.en: Taowei had a fierce temper; when angered his beard would bristle.
units.literal: Taowei was high-spirited; when angry his beard and whiskers would bristle.

units.zh: 每有大議，必毅然決之。
units.en: On every major issue he decided with unflinching resolve.
units.literal: Whenever there was a great deliberation he would resolve it with firm decision.

units.zh: 雖上有難色，未嘗遽已。
units.en: Even when the throne showed hesitation, he did not quickly back down.
units.literal: Though the emperor showed reluctance, he never quickly desisted.

units.zh: 見權貴無少屈，竟為阿思所陷，時人惜之。
units.en: Before the mighty he never yielded an inch; in the end Asi brought him down, and contemporaries mourned him.
units.literal: In seeing the powerful he never bent in the slightest; in the end he was trapped by Asi, and men of the time lamented it.

units.zh: 二子，曰圖木、轄式。
units.en: He had two sons, Tumu and Xiashi.
units.literal: Two sons, named Tumu and Xiashi.

units.zh: 阿思死，始獲進用。
units.en: Only after Asi's death did they come into favor.
units.literal: When Asi died, they at last gained advancement.

units.zh: 蕭塔剌葛，字陶哂，六院部人。
units.en: Xiao Talage, styled Taoshen, was from the Six Yuan Division.
units.literal: Xiao Talage, style name Taoshen, was a man of the Six Yuan Division.

units.zh: 素剛直。
units.en: By nature he was upright and unyielding.
units.literal: By nature he was upright and firm.

units.zh: 太祖時，坐叔祖臺哂謀殺於越釋魯，沒入弘義宮。
units.en: Under Taizu he was implicated when his granduncle Taishan plotted to murder yuyue Shilu and was entered into the Hongyi Palace rolls.
units.literal: In Taizu's time he was implicated because his granduncle Taishan plotted to murder yuyue Shilu and was confiscated into the Hongyi Palace division.

units.zh: 世宗即位，以舅氏故，出其籍，補國舅別部敞史。
units.en: When Emperor Shizong took the throne, because of his maternal kinship he was removed from the rolls and appointed chanshi of the imperial maternal uncle separate division.
units.literal: When Emperor Shizong took the throne, because of his maternal kinship his register was cleared and he was appointed chanshi of the imperial maternal uncle separate division.

units.zh: 或言泰寧王察割有無君心。
units.en: Some said Prince of Taining Chaguo harbored disloyal thoughts toward the throne.
units.literal: Some said Prince of Taining Chaguo harbored thoughts of disloyalty to the ruler.

units.zh: 塔剌葛曰：「彼縱忍行不義，人孰肯從！」
units.en: Talage said, "Even if he could endure acting unjustly, who would follow him!"
units.literal: Talage said, "Even if he could bear to act unjustly, who would follow him!"

units.zh: 他日侍宴，酒酣，塔剌葛捉察割耳，強飲之曰：「上固知汝傲狠，然以國屬，曲加矜憫，使汝在左右，且度汝才何能為。
units.en: On another banquet day, when the wine was deep, Talage seized Chaguo by the ear and forced him to drink, saying, "The emperor surely knows you are arrogant and fierce, yet because you are of the imperial clan he has bent to show compassion, kept you at his side, and judged what your talents could accomplish.
units.literal: Another day at a feast, when the wine was deep, Talage seized Chaguo by the ear and forced him to drink, saying, "The emperor surely knows you are arrogant and fierce, yet because you are of the imperial clan he has bent to show compassion, kept you at his side, and measured what your talents could accomplish.

units.zh: 若長惡不悛，徒自取赤族之禍！」
units.en: If you persist in evil without reform, you will bring annihilation on your house for nothing!"
units.literal: If you persist in evil without reform, you will bring extermination on your house for nothing!"

units.zh: 察割不能答，強笑曰：「何戲之虐也！」
units.en: Chaguo could not answer and forced a laugh, saying, "Why such cruel jesting!"
units.literal: Chaguo could not answer and forced a laugh, saying, "Why such cruel jesting!"

units.zh: 天祿末，塔剌葛為北府宰相，及察割作亂，塔剌葛醉詈曰：「吾悔不殺此逆賊！」
units.en: At the end of the Tianlu era Talage was Northern Court chancellor; when Chaguo rebelled, Talage drunkenly cursed, saying, "I regret I did not kill this traitor!"
units.literal: At the end of the Tianlu era Talage was Northern Court chancellor; when Chaguo rose in rebellion, Talage drunkenly cursed, saying, "I regret I did not kill this traitor!"

units.zh: 尋為察割所害。
units.en: Soon afterward Chaguo killed him.
units.literal: Soon afterward he was killed by Chaguo.

units.zh: 耶律敵祿，字陽隱，孟父楚國王之後。
units.en: Yelü Dilu, styled Yangyin, was a descendant of the Mengfu Prince of Chu.
units.literal: Yelü Dilu, style name Yangyin, was a descendant of the Mengfu Prince of Chu.

units.zh: 性質直，多膂力。
units.en: Plain and upright by nature, he possessed great physical strength.
units.literal: By nature he was plain and upright, with great physical strength.

units.zh: 察割作亂，敵祿聞之，入見壽安王，慷慨言曰：「願得精兵數百，破賊黨。」
units.en: When Chaguo rebelled, Dilu heard the news, went to see Prince Shou'an, and declared passionately, "Give me several hundred crack troops and I will smash the rebel band."
units.literal: When Chaguo rebelled, Dilu heard of it, went in to see Prince Shou'an, and declared with passion, "I wish to have several hundred crack troops to smash the rebel band."

units.zh: 王嘉其忠。
units.en: The prince praised his loyalty.
units.literal: The prince praised his loyalty.

units.zh: 穆宗即位，為北院宣徽使。
units.en: When Emperor Muzong took the throne, he was appointed Northern Court palace commissioner.
units.literal: When Emperor Muzong took the throne, he was made Northern Court palace commissioner.

units.zh: 上以飛狐道狹，詔敵祿廣之。
units.en: Because the Feihu route was narrow, the emperor ordered Dilu to widen it.
units.literal: Because the Feihu route was narrow, the emperor ordered Dilu to widen it.

units.zh: 明年，將兵援河東，至太原，與漢王會於高平，擊周軍，敗之，仍降其眾。
units.en: The next year he led troops to relieve Hedong, reached Taiyuan, joined the King of Han at Gaoping, attacked the Zhou army, defeated it, and also won the surrender of its troops.
units.literal: The next year he led troops to aid Hedong, reached Taiyuan, met with the King of Han at Gaoping, attacked the Zhou army, defeated it, and also induced its troops to surrender.

units.zh: 忻、代二州叛，將兵討之。
units.en: When Xin and Dai prefectures rebelled, he led troops to suppress them.
units.literal: When Xin and Dai prefectures rebelled, he led troops to suppress them.

units.zh: 會耶律撻烈至，敗周師於忻口。
units.en: When Yelü Talie arrived, the Zhou army was defeated at Xinkou.
units.literal: When Yelü Talie arrived, the Zhou forces were defeated at Xinkou.

units.zh: 師還，卒。
units.en: When the army returned, he died.
units.literal: When the army returned, he died.

units.zh: 論曰：忠臣惟知有國，而不知有身，故惡惡不避其患。
units.en: The commentators write: A loyal minister thinks only of the state, not of himself; that is why in denouncing evil he does not shun its cost.
units.literal: Commentary says: The loyal minister knows only the state and does not know his own person; therefore in hating evil he does not avoid its affliction.

units.zh: 阿剌以諂諛不法折蕭革，陶隗以用必基禍言阿思，塔剌葛以忍行不義徒自取赤族之罪責察割，其心可謂忠矣。
units.en: Ala rebuked Xiao Ge for sycophancy and lawlessness; Taowei warned that employing Asi must lay the root of disaster; Talage blamed Chaguo that by persisting in injustice he would only bring annihilation on his own clan — their hearts may be called loyal.
units.literal: Ala by flattery and lawlessness rebuked Xiao Ge; Taowei said that employing Asi must lay the root of disaster; Talage by enduring unjust conduct himself brought extermination upon his clan while blaming Chaguo — their hearts may be called loyal.

units.zh: 言一出而禍輒隨之。
units.en: Yet as soon as they spoke, ruin followed.
units.literal: Once the words were spoken, disaster immediately followed.

units.zh: 籲，邪正既不辨，國焉得無亂哉！
units.en: Alas, when the court could no longer tell straight from crooked, what wonder that the realm fell into disorder!
units.literal: Alas — when evil and upright are no longer distinguished, how can the state escape turmoil!
